posts.text: Addressed the 134th episode of Mann Ki Baat today. Spoke about India's incredible journey, our youth's energy, and the importance of staying connected to our roots. Also urged everyone to stay hydrated and offer water to those in need as heatwave grips parts of India. Take care of each other. 🙏

posts.text: PM inaugurated the 594-km Ganga Expressway in Hardoi, UP — a transformative step for connectivity and growth. Also celebrated Sikkim's 50th Statehood with the launch of 30+ development projects in Gangtok. India is building at an unprecedented pace.

posts.text: Chaired a comprehensive security review in Gujarat. Our approach is clear: zero tolerance for unauthorized encroachments along the international border. Border fencing, maritime security, and political will have transformed Gujarat's security landscape. Infiltration and smuggling have stopped.

posts.text: People are suffering in this extreme heat. Governments must ensure water availability and relief measures for every citizen. Instead of grand inauguration ceremonies, focus on the basics — water, electricity, and healthcare for the common man.

posts.text: Heartfelt birthday wishes to my cabinet colleague Shri Mansukh Mandaviya ji. Wishing him good health, happiness, and continued success in all his endeavours. Also extended warm greetings to Smt. Savitri Thakur ji on her birthday. 🎂

posts.text: Budget 2026 is delivering results. Structural reforms, productivity gains, and technology adoption continue to drive employment and growth. With ₹12.2 lakh crore in capital expenditure and 7 new high-speed rail corridors, India is on a high-growth trajectory.

posts.text: The matters related to our US legal proceedings are now behind us. We did not bend. We did not pause. What defines us is not the noise, but the strength of our response. Before AI can think, energy must flow. Infrastructure and intelligence — that's the future we're building.
posts.caption: The matters related to our US legal proceedings are now behind us. We did not bend. We did not pause. What defines us is not the noise, but the strength of our response. Before AI can think, energy must flow. Infrastructure and intelligence — that's the future we're building.
